base: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE new finished Kalistar card illustration, portrait 4:5. References establish character identity and painterly emotional art direction; do not reproduce the card frame, numbers, typography or UI. Momo is the painterly style anchor, not a robot to include in another character's scene. Preserve race and established character identity when present. ONE PERSON ONLY, no exchange with a second character. Each illustration must be a distinct believable story moment, emotion conveyed through gesture, pose, composition and environment. Keep the important face, hands and story object in central 60% of width and between 12% and 82% height so card stat rails do not cover them. Handcrafted oil-painted textures, expressive selective brushwork, grounded anatomy, coherent gear. No glossy photoreal beauty retouch, no melted metal, repeated fingers, disconnected limbs, generic three-quarter crouch, writing, logos or decorative particles. Scene:
